import math

# Persistent state across calls
state = globals().setdefault('state', {'mode': 'reverse'})

def control(obs):
    # Retrieve current mode
    mode = state['mode']
    hitch = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    # Thresholds (degrees)
    MAX_HITCH = 25.0  # switch to forward pull when exceeded
    ALIGN_HITCH = 5.0  # resume reverse when hitch near zero
    # Speed settings (m/s)
    rev_speed = -0.8  # moderate reverse
    fwd_speed = 1.0   # moderate forward pull
    # Steering logic
    if mode == 'reverse':
        if abs(hitch) > MAX_HITCH:
            # Too much swing – pull forward to reset
            state['mode'] = 'forward'
            steer = -math.copysign(15.0, hitch) if abs(hitch) > 1.0 else 0.0
            speed = fwd_speed
        else:
            # Steer toward the side the trailer is swung to
            steer = math.copysign(15.0, hitch) if abs(hitch) > 1.0 else 0.0
            speed = rev_speed
    else:  # mode == 'forward'
        if abs(hitch) < ALIGN_HITCH:
            # Trailer aligned enough – resume reverse
            state['mode'] = 'reverse'
            steer = math.copysign(15.0, hitch) if abs(hitch) > 1.0 else 0.0
            speed = rev_speed
        else:
            # Pull forward while steering opposite to swing to straighten
            steer = -math.copysign(15.0, hitch) if abs(hitch) > 1.0 else 0.0
            speed = fwd_speed
    # Clamp steering to vehicle limits
    steer = max(min(steer, 45.0), -45.0)
    # Keep head looking straight ahead
    look = 0.0
    return (steer, speed, look)

LOOK_LEFT = 90  # look left while reversing to monitor rails

# Phase tracking variables
phase = 'forward'  # start with a short forward move for clearance
phase_start_t = None  # will be set on first call

    return max(min_val, min(max_val, value))

def control(obs):
    global phase, phase_start_t
    # Initialize phase start time on first call
    if phase_start_t is None:
        phase_start_t = obs.get('t', 0.0)

    status = obs.get('status', '')
    hitch = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)  # positive = trailer rear swung left

    # Phase logic
    if phase == 'forward':
        # Move forward for about 2 seconds to clear the vehicle front from the rails
        if obs.get('t', 0.0) - phase_start_t < 2.0:
            steer = 0.0
            speed = MAX_SPEED_FWD * 0.5  # moderate forward speed (≈0.6 m/s)
            look = LOOK_FORWARD
            return (steer, speed, look)
        else:
            # Switch to reversing phase
            phase = 'reverse'
            phase_start_t = obs.get('t', 0.0)
    # Reversing phase – use proportional steering to keep hitch near zero
    if phase == 'reverse':
        # Simple proportional control: steer towards the side the trailer has swung to
        steer = STEER_GAIN * hitch
        steer = clamp(steer, -MAX_STEER, MAX_STEER)
        speed = -MAX_SPEED_REV * 0.75  # 75% of default reverse speed for stability
        look = LOOK_LEFT
        return (steer, speed, look)
    # Fallback – stop
    return (0.0, 0.0, LOOK_FORWARD)

# Trailer reversing controller
# Simple state machine: reverse until hitch angle exceeds threshold, then forward to straighten.

phase = 'reverse'

def control(obs):
    global phase
    hitch = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    # Look at rear camera for trailer view
    look = -41  # degrees (camera direction)
    # Thresholds for switching phases
    if phase == 'reverse':
        if abs(hitch) > 15:
            phase = 'forward'
        else:
            # Proportional steering to reduce hitch angle, limited to max steering
            steer = max(min(0.8 * hitch, 42), -42)
            speed = -0.8  # reverse speed (m/s)
            return steer, speed, look
    if phase == 'forward':
        if abs(hitch) < 5:
            phase = 'reverse'
        steer = 0
        speed = 1.0  # forward speed to straighten trailer
        return steer, speed, look
    # Fallback – stop
    return 0.0, 0.0, look
